newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Aetna, Sul America in Brazil venture.
newsitem.headline: Aetna, Sul America in Brazil venture.

text.p: U.S. insurance company Aetna Inc and Brazil's largest private insurer Sul America Seguros will form a joint-venture to offer life and health insurance services in Brazil, Sul America said in a statement.
Sul America would not disclose further details about the deal.
Chairmen of the two companies will hold a news conference on February 3 at 1530 local/1730 GMT at Sul America headquarters in Rio de Janeiro city to officially announce the deal, the statement said.
Sul America group has an 18.37 percent market share of Brazil's insurance sector. In 1995, the company's premiums totalled 2.8 billion reais.
